1. For U1 (msg bus/binding jar include/exclude): We'll use Maven/Gradle dependency exclusion and inclusion APIs, plus a runtime classloader filtering mechanism to handle binding jar selection, with a fallback to default bindings if no custom setup is detected.
2. For U2 (dependency resolution): We'll implement a custom classloader-based dependency resolution strategy that prioritizes module-specific jar versions, with a fallback to the core classpath version if conflicts are unresolvable, using OSGi-like version matching logic for runtime resolution.
3. For U3 (DockerHub publish): We'll use GitHub Actions for CI/CD, with a Docker multi-stage build to create minimal s-c-d images, and configure DockerHub automated builds tied to the main branch and release tags.
4. For U4 (screencast of firehose/counter pipe): We'll use OBS Studio for recording, with pre-configured s-c-s sample apps for the firehose and counter pipe, and edit the screencast with DaVinci Resolve (free version) to include voiceover and step-by-step walkthrough.
5. For U5 (undeploy for singlenode): We'll implement a REST endpoint for undeploy, reuse the existing deployment metadata store to track running streams, and align the undeploy logic with the existing jobs undeploy strategy as the prerequisite step.
6. For U6 (profiles for Admin app): We'll use Spring Boot's built-in profile support, with a LocalProfile (in-memory metadata store), a CloudProfile (using a relational DB like PostgreSQL), and a default profile that falls back to Local if no profile is set.
7. For U7 (port XD modules to s-c-s foundation): We'll create a base module template that follows s-c-s conventions, with a migration guide document, and reuse existing XD module logic where possible, adapting only for s-c-s's programming model.
8. For U8 (expose counter metrics endpoints): We'll use Spring Boot Actuator's metrics endpoint, expose the counter metrics from the firehose/counter pipe apps via a dedicated /metrics/counters endpoint, and integrate with the existing s-c-d dashboard for visualization.

5. The XD modules to be ported are open source and publicly available, with documentation for their existing functionality.
6. The firehose and counter pipe sample applications for the screencast already exist in the s-c-s examples repository, or can be created quickly using existing s-c-s starters.
7. The existing undeploy logic for jobs in s-c-d is already implemented and can be referenced for the stream undeploy strategy alignment.

technical_and_design_decisions: For binding jar include/exclude (U1): Use a runtime classloader-based filtering mechanism combined with Maven/Gradle dependency exclusion configuration, with fallback to Spring's default binding jars when no custom binding configuration is detected.

For runtime dependency resolution (U2): Implement an OSGi-inspired version matching algorithm that prioritizes module-specific jar versions over core classpath versions, with fallback to the highest compatible core version for unresolvable conflicts.

For DockerHub publishing (U3): Use GitHub Actions for CI/CD with multi-stage Docker builds to create minimal, secure s-c-d images, with automated pushes to DockerHub triggered by main branch pushes and version tags.

For the s-c-s screencast (U4): Use pre-existing s-c-s firehose and counter pipe sample applications for the demo, record with OBS Studio, and edit with DaVinci Resolve (free version) to include voiceover and annotations.

For singlenode undeploy (U5): Reuse existing s-c-d job undeploy metadata tracking logic for streams, and define a consistent undeploy workflow that stops running stream applications, cleans up resources, and removes deployment metadata.

For Admin app profile support (U6): Leverage Spring Boot's native profile configuration, with a Local profile using an in-memory H2 metadata store, a Cloud profile using PostgreSQL, and default fallback to the Local profile if no profile is set.

For XD module porting foundation (U7): Create a base s-c-s module template that encapsulates common XD module functionality (input/output adapters, shared configuration) and follows s-c-s's functional programming model, paired with a migration guide for existing XD modules.

For counter metrics endpoints (U8): Integrate Spring Boot Actuator's Micrometer metrics support into firehose/counter pipe apps, and expose a dedicated /admin/metrics/counters endpoint in the s-c-d Admin app to aggregate and serve metrics to dashboards.
assumptions: The developer has existing write access to the Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and s-c-d DockerHub repositories.
All required development tools (JDK 17+, Maven 3.8+, Docker Desktop, OBS Studio, DaVinci Resolve) are pre-installed and configured on the developer's local machine.
The existing s-c-d Admin application has a pre-built metadata store abstraction layer that can be extended for profile-based backend switching, no need to build the abstraction from scratch.
The XD modules to be ported are part of the open-source Spring XD project, with publicly available source code and documentation.
The firehose and counter pipe sample applications for the screencast are available in the Spring Cloud Stream samples repository, or can be created in under 2 hours using existing s-c-s starters.
The existing s-c-d job undeploy functionality is fully implemented and tested, and can be used as a reference for the consistent stream undeploy strategy.

The dependency resolution feature only needs to handle version conflicts for Spring ecosystem dependencies (e.g., Spring Data, Spring Boot) and does not need to support arbitrary third-party jar conflict resolution for this increment.
The s-c-d dashboard already has built-in support for fetching and displaying external metrics endpoints, requiring only minor configuration changes to integrate the new counter metrics endpoint.

activities.activity_description: Review Spring Framework classloader APIs, Maven/Gradle dependency exclusion features, and existing s-c-d/s-c-s binding jar handling logic to identify feasible approaches for runtime binding selection and fallback.
Build and test a prototype of runtime classloader-based binding jar filtering, validate fallback to default Spring bindings when no custom binding configuration is present.
Write up investigation results, recommended binding selection and fallback mechanism, and present findings to the team for feedback and approval.
Investigate OSGi version matching, Maven dependency resolution algorithms, and Java classloader conflict resolution approaches to select a suitable strategy for s-c-d runtime dependency resolution.

Code the runtime classloader-based dependency resolution logic that prioritizes module-specific jar versions, with fallback to the highest compatible core classpath version for unresolvable conflicts.
Create test cases that simulate multiple modules with conflicting jar versions, validate that the correct version is loaded at runtime and fallback logic works as expected.

activities.activity_name: Optimize s-c-d Dockerfile for multi-stage builds
activities.activity_description: Refactor the existing s-c-d Dockerfile to use multi-stage builds to reduce image size, and validate that the optimized image runs correctly in a local environment.
Set up GitHub Actions workflow to build the s-c-d Docker image on push to the main branch and version tag creation, and configure automated pushes to the s-c-d DockerHub repository.
Test the full CI/CD pipeline by pushing a test commit and version tag, verify the image is successfully published to DockerHub and runs correctly when pulled to a remote environment.

activities.activity_name: Prepare screencast environment and demo script
activities.activity_description: Set up a local s-c-s environment, validate that the firehose and counter pipe sample applications run correctly, and write a step-by-step demo script for the screencast.
Record the step-by-step walkthrough of creating and running the firehose/counter pipe, add voiceover, on-screen annotations, and edit the final video for public release.
Upload the final edited screencast to a public video platform (e.g., YouTube), add descriptive metadata, and share the link with the Spring community.

activities.activity_name: Align consistent undeploy strategy for jobs and streams
activities.activity_description: Review existing s-c-d job undeploy logic, define a consistent undeploy workflow that works for both jobs and streams, and get team sign-off on the strategy as a prerequisite for stream undeploy implementation.
Code the REST endpoint for singlenode stream undeploy, integrate with the existing deployment metadata store to identify running streams, stop their applications, and clean up associated resources.
Create test cases that deploy a stream to a singlenode target, call the undeploy endpoint, and validate that the stream is stopped, resources are cleaned up, and deployment metadata is removed.

Define a common interface for metadata store backends, and map each supported profile (local, cloud, etc.) to its corresponding implementation to enable profile-based backend switching in the Admin app.

activities.activity_name: Implement Local profile in-memory metadata store
activities.activity_description: Code the in-memory metadata store implementation for the Local profile, and integrate it with the Admin application's Spring Boot profile configuration to activate the in-memory store when the local profile is enabled.
Create test cases that run the Admin app with different profiles, validate that the correct metadata store backend is activated and functions as expected for each profile.
Analyze the open-source Spring XD module codebase, identify common patterns, core functionality, and dependencies that need to be ported to the s-c-s programming model.

Create a reusable base module template that follows s-c-s conventions, encapsulates common XD module functionality (input/output adapters, common configuration), and provides a foundation for porting existing XD modules.

activities.activity_name: Document XD to s-c-s migration guide
activities.activity_description: Write a step-by-step migration guide for porting existing XD modules to the new s-c-s base template, including code examples, best practices, and troubleshooting tips.

activities.activity_name: Integrate Spring Boot Actuator metrics for counters
activities.activity_description: Add Spring Boot Actuator and Micrometer dependencies to the firehose and counter pipe applications, and configure metrics collection for the counter functionality.
Create a custom REST endpoint in the s-c-d Admin app that aggregates counter metrics from deployed streams and exposes them in a JSON format suitable for dashboard consumption.

activities.activity_name: Integrate metrics endpoint with s-c-d dashboard
activities.activity_description: Update the s-c-s dashboard to fetch and display counter metrics from the new endpoint, and validate end-to-end metrics flow from the pipe to the dashboard.
